guidance.message: Within this prototype’s consumer-purchase scope; no legal result is guaranteed.
steps: Send a factual written grievance to the seller and preserve a copy.
If unresolved, contact the National Consumer Helpline at 1915 or its official portal.
For formal consumer commission filing, consult the current e-Jagriti guidance and assess deadlines/jurisdiction with a qualified professional.

draft:
Subject: Consumer grievance – request for resolution (ExampleMart)

Dear Customer Support,

I paid INR 2499 on 12-10-2026 for running shoes. The issue is: Refund not received.

Earlier contact with the seller: I emailed support twice; they sent an automated response.
Evidence I currently have: order email, UPI payment receipt, support screenshots.
Resolution I request: Refund or appropriate replacement.

Please review this grievance, confirm receipt, and respond in writing with an appropriate resolution.

Sincerely,
[Your name]
[Contact details]
[Date]

Note: User-review draft of a seller grievance, not a lawyer-vetted legal notice.
